proposals.evidence: The full response is tum/tūm plus log people. CDIAL 10511 gives Hindi tum; 11119 gives Prakrit lōga people and an Old Bengali plural-affix use. Two ordered components preserve this pluralising expression, including source vowel length and word spacing. This is not a single inherited Sanskrit compound and does not settle local Indo-Aryan transmission. Exact response: tumlog.
